content.text: Follow the action with our live blog Updated 27/03/2026 16:54 CDT Hello and welcome to another MARCA in English live blog. Anticipation is building ahead of tonight's international friendly between England and Uruguay, a fixture that blends rich history with an intriguing modern edge. While officially a friendly, both sides will treat the occasion as a valuable test against elite opposition ahead of the 2026 World Cup. England, guided by a talented core, are expected to lean on the creativity of Jude Bellingham and the clinical finishing of captain Harry Kane. With a squad brimming with depth and technical quality, the Three Lions will aim to dominate possession and impose their attacking style early on. Uruguay, however, arrive with their trademark intensity and resilience. The South American side boasts a dangerous forward line led by Darwin Nunez, whose pace and directness can trouble any defence. Known for their physicality and tactical discipline, Uruguay are unlikely to be overawed and will look to exploit transitions and set-piece opportunities. Beyond the result, the match offers both managers a chance to experiment with systems and personnel ahead of competitive fixtures later in the year. For England, it's about maintaining momentum and cohesion; for Uruguay, it's another opportunity to showcase their evolving style on the international stage. With contrasting approaches and plenty of individual quality on display, tonight's encounter promises to be more than just a routine friendly, it could be a compelling contest that hints at what both nations might achieve in the near future. England vs Uruguay - Latest Updates What time does England vs Uruguay start? England vs Uruguay kicks off at 19:45 GMT in the UK, offering an evening start for home fans.
